description: Source code for kivy.core.audio_output module, including Sound and SoundLoader classes, managing audio provider registration, loading, and playback functionality.

classes.name: SoundLoader
classes.description: Class responsible for registering sound provider classes, listing available providers, and loading sounds with provider selection.

classes.name: Sound
classes.description: Class representing an audio sound object, with properties and methods for playback control, source management, and event dispatching.

methods.name: SoundLoader.register
methods.description: Registers a new sound provider class for loading sounds.

methods.name: SoundLoader.available_providers
methods.description: Returns a list of available sound provider names.

methods.name: SoundLoader.load
methods.description: Loads a sound file using the best available provider or a specified provider.

methods.name: Sound.load
methods.description: Loads the sound file into memory (to be implemented by provider).

methods.name: Sound.unload
methods.description: Unloads the sound from memory (to be implemented by provider).

methods.name: Sound.seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the sound (to be implemented by provider).

methods.name: Sound.on_play
methods.description: Event handler called when the sound starts playing.

methods.name: Sound.on_stop
methods.description: Event handler called when the sound stops playing.
